title: [AINews] Google admits AI Mode hurts Search revenue; -15% $500B drop worst since 2004 IPO. AI Bear Market coming?
author: swyx .ai
description: It turns out you cannot have your cake AND eat it
summary: As an engineer-focused newsletter we only very rarely let financial stories through (our last example was Jan 2025 ), but when this is about the future of Google and Google Search , with a recently departed AI leadership, you cannot not care. At its heart is the tension between overview pages and underlying pages they summarize.
takeaways: Frontier and Open Model Releases Gemini 4 Carbon (Google DeepMind) : The model is ranked #1 in Text Arena, #2 in Agent Arena and #4 in WebDev, and changed the Pareto frontier in all three ( Arena ).
Smaller and specialized models : Microsoft computer-use agent : A 4B hybrid agent that can both click and write code scores 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified, ahead of 27B and 30B agents ( @HuggingPapers ).
AI Twitter Recap Claude Ultra Drops the 5-Hour Limit as Anthropic Renames Its Max Tiers Plan rename : Anthropic renamed its Max tiers.
